description: Find a Folketinget (Danish Parliament) member or party by name and return the stable actor id to use in the other tools. kind "member" (default "any") matches people by name part and returns member_id, name, party short code and name, and profession; kind "party" matches party groups by name or short code (S, V, DF, SF, EL, LA, M, KF, RV, ALT, DD, BP, IA) and returns the party with its group actor ids (one per parliamentary term). A name that matches nothing returns found false with the nearest names, never an empty success. Source: Folketinget, actor register.

kind.description: Restrict to people or parties (default any).

name.description: Name or part of a name, e.g. "Egelund", "Mette Frederiksen", "Radikale", or a party short code like "SF".

name: folketinget_dk_find_actor
title: Folketinget Dk Find Actor
